Type: ottoman
Name: Rivet Asher Modern Storage Ottoman, 15.75"W, Fabric, Navy (Renewed)
Colors: Navy
Complete your modern-style interior decorating with this tastefully elegant ottoman. With a sleek design and a storage compartment under its lid, this ottoman is an ideal combination of style, comfort, and functionality. 15.75"W x 15.75"D x 16"H; seat height: 16"H; seat depth: 15.75"D Solid-wood frame with 100% polyester upholstery Storage ottoman with comfortable navy fabric This ottoman's simple elegance perfectly complements a modern-style room. No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
